Prepared 15 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 12 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-12.1 · Evidence research-2026-11-11.candidate.1

Evidence & scope

The complete retained annotation-service, About and privacy texts and company-authored September 2025 release were actually read in this new metadata phase. They support one commercial SunTec.ai operating division within the SunTec India group offering human-in-the-loop image, video, text, audio and 3D annotation with domain-trained teams, project taxonomies, multi-tier human/automatic QA, gold/agreement/consensus procedures and batch/API delivery. Anonymous restaurant/map/drone case descriptions document the provider-reported task scope and human work, without independent buyer confirmation or approved outcome metrics. The issuer-authored release explicitly identifies SunTec.ai as SunTec India’s division; retain org.suntec_ai as the existing group bridge rather than adding another parent or division supplier count. Exact registered contracting entity, ownership beyond that divisional statement, workforce composition and active headcount, revenue, actual 99% accuracy and all certification claims remain unverified. Website processor instructions and FAQ ownership/retention/destruction statements are limited published terms, not executed contracts or upstream rights clearance for a particular corpus. This scoped capability/process/identity/limits audit supports supplier classification conditional on separate coordinator commercial/group metadata acceptance and import of the exact five already-three-role-passed own-subject facts. It creates no new scientific wording or PASS, service-quality assurance, all-catalog rights or research-source-function closure.
